findings.issue: The chime control fell below the phone viewport.
findings.fix: Reduced mobile dial and vertical spacing, with a short-screen size.
findings.evidence: Chrome at 320×740, 375×812 and 390×844 has the chime row within the viewport.

findings.issue: At 1280×800 desktop spacing created five pixels of vertical scroll.
findings.fix: Reduced bottom padding at short desktop heights.
findings.evidence: Final capture uses the desktop height media query.

findings.issue: Tabular punctuation shifted the countdown colon toward the seconds.
findings.fix: Kept tabular numerals on the digits and used normal punctuation metrics for the colon.
findings.evidence: Final laptop and phone captures show balanced spacing.

idea: The oversized editable countdown is the main object, with a separate control column and the existing tomato brand.
old_page_did_better: The compact old card placed related controls close together; the new layout restores that compactness on phones and keeps a clear relationship between the display and controls on desktop.
preserve: The live timer dominates the screen; no extra sections or decorative copy.

verification.alternative_render: headless Chrome through existing Playwright; five screenshot sizes and nine responsive checks
verification.wiring: 28 IDs, 9 inputs, 1 link and 1 script preserved
